item.subject: science
item.stem: Meena's teacher shows the class a globe and says that nearly three-fourths of Earth's surface is covered with water. Yet Meena's village in Tamil Nadu faces a shortage of water for drinking, cooking and farming every summer. Which statement best explains this?

options.A: The water in oceans slowly disappears into the sky, so it is lost forever.
options.B: Most of Earth's water is salty seawater, which cannot be used for drinking, farming or household work, and freshwater is limited.
options.C: Earth has no water stored under the ground, so villages cannot get any water.
options.D: Rainwater is salty, so it cannot be collected and used in homes.
